text:
deploy-orch-bot: starting deploy to prod/us-east :rocket:
deploy-orch-bot: image tag: v3.4.1
deploy-orch-bot: commits included:
  - ab12c9f4 (MayaP) https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/commit/ab12c9f4
  - c3d4e5f2 (OmarV) https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/commit/c3d4e5f2
  - 7f8e9a01 (AliceC) https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/commit/7f8e9a01
deploy-orch-bot: PR refs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/842 (MayaP), https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/851 (OmarV)
deploy-orch-bot: rollout plan: canary 5% -> 25% (30m) -> 100% (1h)
Maya Patel: quick note — the cache-key change in ab12c9f4 fixed a memory leak in staging, but we saw a small spike in latency at seq_len 2048. watching closely.
Omar Vazquez: posted perf graphs in #eng-releases earlier, baseline 95p latency up ~120ms during one test run. Not blocking but worth note.
Alice Chen: request: pin this deploy to v3.4.1 tag in prod hosts for 2h after rollout start. If we see >1% 5xx or errors in latency at p95 > 500ms, we rollback.
SRE Oncall: ack. I'll set an alert for 5xx rate > 0.8% for 10m and p95 > 450ms.
Maya Patel: adding a short rollback checklist here:
``` 
# rollback checklist
1) orch rollback --to sha=7f8e9a01 --env=prod-us-east
2) remove v3.4.1 from canary pool
3) open incident channel #incidents-prod and tag oncall
4) collect kv-cache metrics and forward to infra
```
Omar Vazquez: FYI the PRs include a hotfix in PR#851 that touched batching code. If we rollback to 7f8e9a01 we'll lose that batching fix; consider rolling back only frontend gate if possible.
Alice Chen: good call — can we do a partial rollback (routing) instead of full image rollback?
deploy-orch-bot: partial rollback supported: set routing override to stable tag v3.4.0 for canary subset. Command:
``` 
orch routing set --env prod-us-east --subset canary --tag v3.4.0
```
SRE Oncall: doing a dry-run alert now. will post updates in 15m.
Maya Patel: note added to release notes draft: "v3.4.1: cache key normalization, batching tweak; monitor memory + p95 latency."
Omar Vazquez: thumbs up. tagging PR authors: @MayaP @OmarV @AliceC
Alice Chen: thanks — i'll stay on call for the 30m canary. ping me if alerts hit. :eyes:
deploy-orch-bot: canary 5% steady at +6m. no errors above threshold. advancing to 25% now. :white_check_mark:
SRE Oncall: alert fired (p95 480ms) at +22m, investigating traces.
Maya Patel: digging into traces, suspect KV cache warmup causing p95 spike, mitigation: increase prefill concurrency for first minute. patch ready in PR 859.
Alice Chen: decision call: hold at 25% for an extra 20m while patch rolls out to canary subset. if p95 drops under 420ms and 5xx remains <0.5% we'll continue.
deploy-orch-bot: rollout paused at 25%. annotating deploy: "paused for perf investigation"
Omar Vazquez: if perf doesn't improve in 20m we opt for routing override to v3.4.0 for canary and open rollback if needed.
SRE Oncall: will post final decision after 20m window.
Maya Patel: pushing PR 859 -> canary subset now. patch commit d4e5f6a7 https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/commit/d4e5f6a7
deploy-orch-bot: canary subset updated with d4e5f6a7. monitoring...
SRE Oncall: p95 trending down to 410ms after patch. 5xx stable at 0.12%.
Alice Chen: good to proceed. continue to 100% per plan.
deploy-orch-bot: advancing to 100% rollout. completed at +1h5m. release tag v3.4.1 live in prod/us-east :tada:
Maya Patel: noted in release notes and changelog. will follow up with post-deploy verification run tomorrow morning.
Omar Vazquez: adding commit attribution to release email: ab12c9f4 (Maya Patel), c3d4e5f2 (Omar Vazquez), 7f8e9a01 (Alice Chen), d4e5f6a7 (Maya Patel).
SRE Oncall: closing monitoring window for this deployment — no incidents. good job team :party_parrot:
